name: The Northwood Club
_comment_tees: Scorecard from GolfPass (12693); its pars match OpenStreetMap's hole tags (par 71). Tee I (7039 yards) has no hole-by-hole row, so the longest is I/II; the other combination tees are left out. Men's ratings, each for its own length.
_comment_drop: Polygons containing these points are not part of the course: nothing here; trim_far.py drops the practice greens, short-game area and range tee.
_comment_shift: OSM outlines sit this many metres off the Esri imagery; every point is moved by it (fitted to the bunkers on sand; the greens agree).
